## Summary

| Evidence | Result |
|---|---|
| Finite-difference gradient checks | 35 op cases + 9 whole-model cases; worst max. relative deviation 1.18e-6 (tolerance 1e-5) |
| TF.js parity | 7 / 7 architectures agree on every loss and every parameter after every step (≥ 100 steps); worst abs. deviation: loss 2.88e-7, parameters 7.29e-7 |
| Determinism (engine) | 7 / 7 architectures bit-identical across repeats, seed-sensitive, and identical after checkpoint resume |
| Determinism (trace) | 7 / 7 traces have identical SHA-256 over 3 repeated runs and differ under another seed |
| Frame rate while auto-stepping (Chromium) | 59.9 fps (operation), 60.2 fps (layer), 60.2 fps (example) |

## 1. Gradient checks (`tests/gradcheck`)

Central differences with h = 10⁻⁶ in float64, on L = Σ f(x) ⊙ R for a random fixed tensor R (so off-diagonal Jacobian errors cannot cancel). Relative deviation |a − n| / max(|a|, |n|, 10⁻⁷). Tolerance: 10⁻⁵. A deliberately wrong rule is shown to fail with relative deviation > 0.3, so the check is not vacuous.

## 2. TF.js parity (`tests/parity`)

For each planned architecture, TF.js 4.22 (CPU backend, float32, its own autodiff) trains the same network from identical seeded initial weights on the identical batch order, independently of our engine (float64, per-sample accumulation). Criterion at every step: |ours − tf| ≤ 10⁻⁴ + 10⁻³·|tf| for the batch loss and for every parameter. Rationale in ADR-009.

| Architecture | Steps | Parameters | Max |Δ loss| | Max |Δ param| | Final loss (ours / TF.js) | Pass |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CNN (conv3x3 p1 ReLU, maxpool2, conv3x3 s1, avgpool2, flatten, dense softmax) | 102 | 157 | 1.14e-7 | 3.88e-7 | 0.703547 / 0.703547 | yes |
| CNN with strided, padded convolution (conv3x3 s2 p1 sigmoid, maxpool2, flatten, dense sigmoid) | 102 | 47 | 1.44e-7 | 3.21e-7 | 1.066803 / 1.066803 | yes |
| Vanishing gradients (2-4-4-4-4-1 sigmoid stack) | 100 | 77 | 5.40e-8 | 4.30e-7 | 0.718984 / 0.718984 | yes |
| Gradient descent (linear neuron, MSE) | 100 | 2 | 1.58e-7 | 3.90e-7 | 0.008838 / 0.008838 | yes |
| Forward/backprop MLP (2-8-3, ReLU, softmax + CCE, momentum) | 102 | 51 | 2.22e-7 | 7.29e-7 | 0.543836 / 0.543836 | yes |
| XOR with an MLP (2-4-1, tanh/sigmoid, BCE) | 100 | 17 | 1.07e-7 | 7.27e-7 | 0.159276 / 0.159276 | yes |
| Single neuron / logistic unit | 100 | 3 | 2.88e-7 | 5.78e-7 | 0.037787 / 0.037787 | yes |

The overlay plot `figures/parity-overlay.pdf` shows the two loss curves for the XOR experiment and the CNN on top of each other, with the per-step absolute differences below.
